warhead.provenance: Payload is a Yu-7-class lightweight torpedo with 45 kg shaped-charge warhead per OOB (csg-cn-yu8-gs, C-only); warhead fields carried unchanged from the packet's Yu-7 record since CY-5/Yu-8 is a delivery rocket, not an independent warhead design.

fuze.provenance: Fuze belongs to the payload torpedo (Yu-7-class); carried unchanged from the packet's Yu-7 record, engineering-estimate contact fuze scaffold.

_real_world.designation: DESIGNATION CONFLICT: 'CY-5' (export CY-series lineage, Wikipedia/GlobalMilitary, C-tier) vs 'Yu-8' (PRC-media designation for the Type 054A VLS rocket-assisted torpedo per GlobalSecurity translation, C-tier); AFCEA (B) mentions 'Changying-5'. Probably the same functional weapon per OOB; treated as one sim entity pending resolution
_real_world.role: Stand-off ASW rocket-boosted flight, releases a lightweight torpedo (Yu-7 class) near datum; 'certain anti-ship capability' also claimed (C-only)
_real_world.range_nmi: LARGE CONFLICT per OOB: ~30 km (CY-5, C-tier) / 'about 50 km' design goal for Changying-2 -> Yu-8 (C-only) / AFCEA 5-8 km (B, likely a pre-service 2014-era estimate). Scenario band 20-50 km per OOB; this record models the AFCEA B-tier 5-8 km figure's upper bound as the conservative primary, noting the C-tier 20-50 km scenario band as the alternate
_real_world.flight_speed: >Mach 1.5 max, Mach 0.7 terminal cruise; glide trajectory rather than purely ballistic (C-only, translation of Chinese-language material)
_real_world.payload: Yu-7-class lightweight torpedo, 45 kg warhead (Yu-11 payload for newer rounds not public)
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — ASW stand-off rockets have no matching NavalWeaponType (not a vls_sam per task's mount rules, since it is not an anti-air/anti-missile SAM); placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory. Launch platforms: Type 054A 32-cell VLS (shared with HHQ-16, compatible launch control); Type 052D/055 universal VLS reported (unconfirmed); Type 056A via YJ-83 boxes (not applicable to this packet's hull list)
_real_world.cells_per_missile: 1 per VLS cell (rocket-booster + 324 mm torpedo fits the 054A strike-length cell; no multi-packing reported)

Range LARGE CONFLICT per OOB (~30 km C-tier vs ~50 km design-goal C-only vs 5-8 km AFCEA B-tier pre-service estimate): this record models the AFCEA B-tier figure as the conservative primary per authoring-standard preference ordering (B > C), while flagging the much larger C-tier 20-50 km scenario band as the noted alternate — this is one of this packet's highest outcome-risk proxies given the ~6x range spread between tiers.

A separate GlobalSecurity-translated figure claims a Type 054B 'Yu-8' variant with 100 km maximum range (csg-cn-yu8-054b-gs, C-only); per OOB explicit instruction this is implausible for a Yu-8-class round and is flagged, not used, in this record.
No functional mount exists (mechanism gap, ASW stand-off rocket); content-only for _real_world.weapon_inventory on Type 054A (confirmed) and Type 052D/055 (unconfirmed per OOB, noted as 'reported').
